youtube.title: Kya Aapne Kabhi Radioactive Cheez Khayi Hai? 🍌 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Aapne jitne bhi kele khaye hain, sab thoda sa radioactive the. Kele mein potassium bharpoor hota hai, aur natural potassium ka ek chhota sa hissa radioactive hota hai. Scientists to kele se radiation naapne ka mazaak bhi karte hain.

Par ghabraiye mat. Ek kela aapko utna radiation deta hai jitna aap roz ki zindagi mein ek ghante mein le lete hain. Aapka body potassium ka level steady rakhta hai aur extra bahar nikal deta hai. Aur twist ye hai: aapke body mein bhi wahi radioactive potassium hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
